title: CPF Module Schema: Key Vault Secret module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-keyvaultsecret'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

content_type.description: (Optional) Specifies the content type of the Key Vault Secret.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

key_vault_id.description: (Required) The ID of the Key Vault where the Secret should be created. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

name.description: (optional) Key name to be used (max 127 chars)

not_before_date.description: (Optional) Key not usable before the provided UTC datetime (Y-m-d'T'H:M:S'Z').

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

value.description: (Required) Specifies the value of the Key Vault Secret. Changing this will create a new version of the Key Vault Secret.

id.description: The Resource ID of the Key Vault Secret.

name.description: The Name of the Key Vault Secret.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Keyvaultsecret' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
